name: Round Rock Public Library Teen Advisory Board
what_you_do: Help the teen librarian plan teen programs, pick new books and promote events. Members volunteer at library programs at least 3 times a year. They earn community service hours.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 13 to 18. The page does not state a residency rule.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Members earn community service hours and recognition.
duration: Meets monthly on the 4th Tuesday at 6:30 pm
deadline_text: The page says no positions are open now. An application form is posted when positions open. No dates are given.
how_to_apply: Watch the library volunteer page for the application form. Questions go to Teen Librarian Jane Dance at jdance@roundrocktexas.gov or 512-218-7012.
notes: New members attend an orientation. Members also tidy and shelve on the 2nd floor.
